caption: Data becomes a root raised cosine pulse, crosses the channel and is matched by the same filter at the receiver; only the cascade is the raised cosine whose eye is watched at the end. Notice that no single filter block is a raised cosine by itself; only their cascade is.

spec.title: Where the raised cosine is made
spec.aria: The data passes through a root raised cosine transmit filter, the channel and a matched receive filter, so the overall pulse seen by the sampler is a raised cosine whose eye is measured at the end.
